paper.note: The paper describes this release. Its coverage figures are the paper's, not recomputed by this export; the counts of this snapshot are measured separately.

catalogDifference.note: The paper reports 809 benchmark tools; this source snapshot exposes 809 benchmark tools plus 15 framework helpers (authentication and shared utilities).

provenance.scope: All .py files under APIs/ of the release's API files: every benchmark service, its tests, authentication, and shared utilities. All 36 Schemas/*.json files retained. No runtime databases, task/user data, compiled bytecode, .env files, scripts outside APIs/, or evaluation results are exported. No source code is executed.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.origin: LICENSE of the public MultiVerse release repository, preserved verbatim. Source file headers are preserved byte for byte.

statistics.methodology: Measured from the exported source bytes. Physical lines include comments, docstrings, and blanks. Code lines count physical lines containing a Python token other than comments, whitespace, or actual module/class/function docstrings. Tests include tests/ directories, test_*.py, and conftest.py; shared implementation excludes tests. These counts are not coverage measurements.
